contradiction_and_null_results: Training-selected DERD won 9 of 20 primary comparisons and lost or tied 11.
The 95% bootstrap confidence interval for mean DERD-minus-baseline RMSE crossed zero and exceeded the +0.02 noninferiority margin.
DERD 90% intervals under-covered at 0.68 to 0.70 pooled coverage, depending on residual scaling.
Periodic KRR became competitive after widening the length-scale range; this changed the baseline selected on 14 of 20 stars.
Three targets still selected the expanded kernel length-scale upper boundary and remain flagged.
No complete official OGLE files were obtained because the isolated runtime could not resolve the host.
independence_note: The data mirrors and software repository establish provenance and executability, not independent astrophysical replication.
physical_claim_boundary: No light-curve result promotes internal Kepler motion, universal transparent shells, or shell mass.
precision_objective: Test whether leakage-resistant selection, a nonlinear periodic baseline, staged period checks, and uncertainty calibration alter the bounded C17 evidence assessment.
rights_and_reuse: OGLE acknowledgement remains mandatory. No claim is made that the 24-row excerpts are complete official light curves.
